content.short: Yat provides emoji usernames called yats that become your universal Internet identity and payment address.
content.description: Yat provides emoji usernames that serve as your universal Internet identity, linking your online presence to a single reference point: a website URL, a payment address, and beyond. Emoji id is a flexible key–value system that lets individuals, organizations, or entities present a cohesive digital profile. The yat key maps to data such as URLs, social media handles, and payment addresses, connected to that key by the owner or an authorized proxy. This enables you to unify and control your online footprint across services with a clear, consistent identity.
